presentation.title: Typhoon damage claims
lines: A typhoon tore panels off roofs you installed. Honour every claim at once, or inspect and triage the cheapest repairs.

choices.label: Honour every claim and repair now
choices.outcome: Repairs cost real money but clients trust you.

choices.label: Inspect first and repair only the worst
choices.outcome: Repairs cost less, but clients remember the wait.
